channel.title: Hlido — AI agent reviews
channel.description: Independent C2PA-verified reviews of AI agents. Every claim tested, scored on the Laddoo scale, signed with cryptographic provenance.

item.title: claude-mermaid — Laddoo 80/100
item.description: A two-tool MCP server that does one narrow job — live Mermaid previews inside Claude Code — and documents it better than most products ten times its size.

item.title: Proliferate — Laddoo 73/100
item.description: Open-source, self-hostable workspace for running coding agents in parallel — a review-first orchestration layer over Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and Grok.

item.title: Excel MCP Server — Laddoo 80/100
item.description: MCP server that drives the real Microsoft Excel engine via its COM API — the honest, high-fidelity answer to Excel automation for agents, not another openpyxl file rewriter.

item.title: Srclight — Laddoo 72/100
item.description: Local-first code-indexing MCP server for AI agents — hybrid FTS5 + tree-sitter + embeddings in a single SQLite file, fully offline, 25 tools.

item.title: MCP-NixOS — Laddoo 78/100
item.description: MCP server that gives AI real, current NixOS / Home Manager / nix-darwin / flakes data so it stops hallucinating package and option names — narrow, well-built and context-frugal.

item.title: AnyFrame — Laddoo 71/100
item.description: A harness-agnostic platform for spinning up team agents inside Slack/Linear/GitHub — a clean concept and real SDK, but visibly pre-traction and crowded on differentiation.

item.title: Katalyst — Laddoo 73/100
item.description: A focused AI sales agent that keeps Salesforce current and preps reps for calls — named enterprise references and a real security posture, thin on programmatic openness.

item.title: Axel — Laddoo 70/100
item.description: A native-Mac control room for dispatching coding agents — a thoughtful niche tool with a strong approval model, judged on a thin public surface.

item.title: ForceDream — Laddoo 70/100
item.description: A genuinely agent-native execution runtime — discover, price, execute and cryptographically verify agent work over A2A/MCP — wrapped in oversized "sovereign OS" language and still very small.

item.title: Maritime — Laddoo 75/100
item.description: Agent-first hosting that gives every agent its own micro-VM at a flat $1/month — a genuinely differentiated infra bet, still early and self-benchmarked.

item.title: Framelink — Laddoo 80/100
item.description: Public-surface review of glips-figma-context-mcp.

item.title: Excel MCP Server — Laddoo 74/100
item.description: Public-surface review of haris-musa-excel-mcp-server.

item.title: EvalView — Laddoo 70/100
item.description: Public-surface review of hidai25-eval-view.

item.title: DroidMind — Laddoo 71/100
item.description: Public-surface review of hyperb1iss-droidmind.

item.title: Construct — Laddoo 76/100
item.description: Public-surface review of construct-computer.

item.title: Agnost AI — Laddoo 78/100
item.description: Public-surface review of agnost.

item.title: agent-lsp — Laddoo 79/100
item.description: Public-surface review of blackwell-systems-agent-lsp.

item.title: RobotMCP — Laddoo 81/100
item.description: Public-surface review of lpigeon-ros-mcp-server.

item.title: vmware-aiops (agent skill) — Laddoo 56/100
item.description: An installable agent skill for VMware AIOps distributed through skills.sh, with a real but modest adoption signal (a few hundred installs) — and a public surface too thin to judge what the skill actually does in depth.

item.title: Augments — Laddoo 73/100
item.description: A focused MCP server that hands Claude Code real type signatures, prose docs and working examples for any npm package — not a curated list — so the model stops guessing from stale training data.

item.title: MCP.Link — Laddoo 72/100
item.description: Turns any OpenAPI specification into Model Context Protocol endpoints, so an AI assistant can call an existing API as MCP tools with no custom integration code.

item.title: Octocode — Laddoo 82/100
item.description: Evidence-first code research for AI agents — 13 read-only tools over GitHub, npm and local code that return answers with citations, shipped as an MCP server, a CLI, a skill and an agent harness, all MIT-licensed with no indexing.

item.title: Shrimp Task Manager — Laddoo 75/100
item.description: An MCP task manager that gives AI coding assistants long-term memory, structured task decomposition with dependencies, and execution tracking — aimed squarely at the 'assistant forgets across conversations' problem.

item.title: Octocode (muvon) — Laddoo 78/100
item.description: A Rust, local-first semantic code-search and knowledge-graph tool that turns a codebase into a queryable graph and exposes it to AI assistants over MCP — sub-2-second indexing, 12+ languages, Apache-2.0.

item.title: PhpCodeArcheology — Laddoo 77/100
item.description: A PHP static-analysis tool that measures architecture rather than just style — 60+ metrics, 14 problem detectors and six output formats — and is, by its own claim, the first PHP analyzer with a native MCP server and a generated CLAUDE.md.

item.title: Supabase MCP Server — Laddoo 85/100
item.description: The official, hosted MCP bridge to a Supabase project — well-documented, scopable to read-only, and honest enough to open with the security risk rather than bury it.

item.title: agent-device — Laddoo 80/100
item.description: Playwright's snapshot-and-act model, ported to native mobile and TV — a token-efficient device-automation CLI built specifically for agents, from a team that knows the mobile tooling space.

item.title: codebase-memory-mcp — Laddoo 82/100
item.description: A structural-analysis backend for coding agents — indexes a repo into a persistent knowledge graph so the agent answers structural questions with far fewer tokens, and it is honest that it holds no LLM of its own.

item.title: agentmako — Laddoo 74/100
item.description: A local-first MCP server that gives coding agents a live, queryable map of your repo — a broad typed-tool surface and a durable 'findings' layer, from a small but Apache-licensed project.

item.title: gograph — Laddoo 80/100
item.description: Compiler-aware repository context for Go coding agents — a local structural graph with optional type-checked enrichment, and a genuinely unusual commitment to publishing its own benchmark ground truth.

item.title: HyperProbe — Laddoo 71/100
item.description: A YC-backed AI on-call agent with a genuinely differentiated mechanism — it has your coding agent drop a read-only probe on the exact prod line that failed, capturing evidence your logs never had, without a redeploy.

item.title: klaw — Laddoo 64/100
item.description: A 'kubectl for AI agents' with a clean single-binary, Slack-and-CLI orchestration story — undercut by an enterprise logo wall (Apple, Amazon, VMware) that a public-beta product has no business displaying unverified.

item.title: Statewright — Laddoo 73/100
item.description: Protocol-level guardrails for coding agents — turns a large task into bounded workflow phases with per-phase tool policy and model routing, so a destructive tool literally does not exist in a read-only state.

item.title: Codex CLI — Laddoo 85/100
item.description: Codex CLI 0.149.1 — OpenAI’s terminal coding agent. CLI surface live-tested from a cold npm install: strong command breadth, sandbox subcommand, trusted-directory guard, excellent doctor — but non-interactive exec hangs silently without credentials instead of failing fast (verified). Agentic loop requires paid auth (untested); medium confidence.

item.title: Clara — Laddoo 57/100
item.description: A polished AI-SDR surface carrying superlatives it does not substantiate — the product may be fine, but the marketing is running well ahead of the evidence.

item.title: Django ORM Lens — Laddoo 84/100
item.description: An unusually honest developer tool: schema intelligence for Django delivered MIT-licensed with an explicit refusal to build a paid tier, and 13 read-only MCP tools that make it genuinely agent-native.

item.title: MCP Toolbox for Databases — Laddoo 85/100
item.description: Google's open-source MCP server for enterprise databases — dual-purpose, well-documented, and already tracking the newest stateless MCP spec.

item.title: Neo4j MCP Integrations — Laddoo 74/100
item.description: Vendor-official MCP integration guidance for Neo4j that is unusually candid about the protocol's unsolved problems — strong on trust, thin on the servers themselves.

item.title: Airtable MCP — Laddoo 79/100
item.description: 42 documented Airtable tools over MCP, MIT-licensed and installable in one line — a rare case where the tool inventory is published up front instead of discovered after install.

item.title: SuperHQ — Laddoo 63/100
item.description: A genuinely good idea — coding agents isolated in microVMs with diff approval — shipped as an unnotarized macOS-only binary with early-stage traction.

item.title: FeedOracle — Laddoo 80/100
item.description: Stablecoin compliance evidence built on an unusually disciplined premise: it reports what a named source showed at a named time, marks the gaps as gaps, and refuses to hand you a verdict.

item.title: Clark Labs — Laddoo 66/100
item.description: Two credible products — a cloud agent that keeps working with the tab closed and a memory-carrying desktop coding agent — wrapped in a lab claim nobody outside can check.

item.title: Roomote — Laddoo 78/100
item.description: A cloud coding agent that takes ownership seriously — self-hostable, single-tenant, model-agnostic BYOK, and it runs your actual app before claiming the work is done.

item.title: screenpipe — Laddoo 81/100
item.description: Local-first computer history that any approved AI can search — strong traction, an explicit privacy default, and the rare case where the scary version of the product is the one they chose not to build.

item.title: Claude Code — Laddoo 91/100
item.description: Claude Code 2.1.241 — Anthropic’s terminal coding agent. CLI surface live-tested from a cold npm install: non-interactive print mode, first-class MCP management, legible permission flags, fast clean failure without credentials. Agentic loop requires paid auth (untested); medium confidence.

item.title: Parahelp — Laddoo 75/100
item.description: Attested public-site review is complete across product, use-case, customer-story, and trust surfaces. Publication assets are now the only missing step.

item.title: Fathom — Laddoo 76/100
item.description: A mature, unusually trusted AI meeting notetaker — free-forever entry, real compliance posture, and a bot-free capture mode that answers the category's biggest objection.

item.title: Feishu MCP Server — Laddoo 52/100
item.description: An early, thin MCP server for automating Feishu (Lark) documents with AI — a real, buildable idea, but the public surface is a minimal no-code landing page with little to verify.

item.title: Intlayer — Laddoo 73/100
item.description: A thoughtfully designed, open-source per-component i18n framework — type-safe, AI-assisted translation, and a visual CMS — that quietly fixes how React/Next/Vue/Svelte apps handle localization.

item.title: CentralMind Gateway — Laddoo 74/100
item.description: An open-source gateway that turns any database into an MCP server or OpenAPI 3.1 in minutes — broad connector coverage and a serious plugin story (PII removal, auth, caching, tracing).
